Package neqsim.util.serialization

Class NeqSimXtream.LoadReport

java.lang.Object
neqsim.util.serialization.NeqSimXtream.LoadReport
Enclosing class:
NeqSimXtream
public static class NeqSimXtream.LoadReport extends Object
Report of what a NeqSimXtream.openNeqsim(String) call skipped, mapped and restored to read a file.
